title: Google Announces the Discontinuation of Android and Wear OS Version of Google Assistant in September 2026, Fully Transitioning to Gemini

content_html:
Google announced that it will stop providing Google Assistant services on the Android and Wear OS platforms starting September 4, 2026, and will be fully replaced by the generative AI assistant Gemini. Google has already sent notification emails to existing users, and this change will affect Android phones, tablets, Wear OS smartwatches, earphones, and in-car systems with Android Auto.

Google stated that after the service migration is completed, users will no longer be able to use Google Assistant or switch back to the previous version. This update is expected to gradually cover all users within a few weeks. However, some cars running Google's system will continue to support Google Assistant. Additionally, Gemini will expand to more devices in the future, including Google TV, Google Home smart speakers, and smart displays.

According to the information, Google had previously planned to shut down Google Assistant-related services in 2025, but later postponed the date to 2026. This adjustment indicates that Google is accelerating its transition from traditional voice assistants to generative AI assistants based on large language models (LLMs).

Compared to Google Assistant, which relies on pre-set instructions and deterministic logic, Gemini has stronger natural language understanding and complex task processing capabilities, but its reliability also faces new challenges. The industry is concerned about whether large language models based on probabilistic models can maintain stable performance in high-frequency scenarios such as controlling smart home devices and performing basic phone operations, and avoid task failures caused by model inference uncertainty.

As tech companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon continue to advance AI assistant upgrades, the smart assistant market is shifting from voice interaction competition to competition based on large model capabilities. Google's replacement of Google Assistant will mark an important step in its AI ecosystem transformation.

content_html_zh:
谷歌宣布将从 2026 年 9 月 4 日起停止在 Android 和 Wear OS 平台上提供 Google Assistant 服务，并由生成式 AI 助手 Gemini 全面取代。 谷歌已经向现有用户发送了通知电子邮件，这一变化将影响Android手机、平板电脑、Wear OS智能手表、耳机以及搭载Android Auto的车载系统。

谷歌表示，服务迁移完成后，用户将无法再使用Google Assistant或切换回之前的版本。 此次更新预计将在几周内逐步覆盖所有用户。 不过，一些运行谷歌系统的汽车将继续支持谷歌助理。 此外，Gemini 未来还将扩展到更多设备，包括 Google TV、Google Home 智能音箱和智能显示器。

信息显示，谷歌此前计划在 2025 年关闭 Google Assistant 相关服务，但后来将日期推迟至 2026 年。 此次调整表明，谷歌正在加速从传统语音助手向基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式AI助手转型。

与依赖预设指令和确定性逻辑的Google Assistant相比，Gemini拥有更强的自然语言理解和复杂任务处理能力，但其可靠性也面临新的挑战。 业界关心基于概率模型的大型语言模型能否在控制智能家居设备、执行基本电话操作等高频场景下保持稳定的性能，并避免因模型推理不确定性而导致的任务失败。

随着苹果、微软、亚马逊等科技公司不断推进AI助手升级，智能助手市场正从语音交互竞争转向基于大模型能力的竞争。 谷歌更换Google Assistant将标志着其AI生态系统转型迈出重要一步。
